description: A white table lamp with a conical lampshade. The base is a square pedestal with a decorative metal cage structure above it, featuring a spherical element within the cage. The stem of the lamp also has a decorative, open metalwork design, tapering towards the lampshade. The overall design is elegant and somewhat ornate, suitable for adding a touch of sophistication to a room. The monochromatic color scheme makes it versatile for various interior designs.
